decisions.reason: A cheap accessory costs almost nothing to keep in the range, but it has not been seen on the website since 2018, which is a weak signal that its value is fading.
Box car trailers are a core category, and the strong 2020-2021 trailer demand makes realizing this option likely, so the line stays despite no recent website evidence.
Car transporters serve a professional niche, and shared production keeps holding costs low, though the missing visibility in later years raises some uncertainty about their value.
Low-bed trailers are a core, versatile segment that benefited from the hauling demand boom, so keeping the option open remains justified.
High covers are low-cost add-ons for existing trailers that preserve upside, so dropping them would release few resources.
This second box trailer series overlaps with B and has no visibility after 2018, which raises consolidation risk, but the evidence is not yet decisive enough to abandon it.
